title: Renewal Loyalty Credits, Residential Electricity Supply: Posting Card
content:
**Rule.** Each renewal of a Residential Electricity Supply agreement earns one renewal loyalty credit, posted on the bill of the billing cycle that starts with the new term, at the renewal loyalty credit amount determined for that renewal rather than the bare plan loyalty credit; a plan whose loyalty credit is 0.00 earns none.

The renewal loyalty credit is not posted until the agreement's current term starts on the day after the contract end date stated on its latest renewal notice, on the plan that notice offers.

The renewal loyalty credit is fixed only after the agreement's bill lines carry the referral credit owed for every referred customer whose agreement has reached the qualifying number of completed cycles.

**Restated as conditions.** The credit is posted only once the agreement's current term begins on the day after the contract end date printed on its latest renewal notice and the agreement is on the plan that notice offers; and its amount is fixed only once the agreement's bill lines carry a referral credit for each referred customer whose agreement has reached the qualifying number of completed cycles.

**Business effect.** Once posted, the agreement's bill lines carry a renewal loyalty credit line on the bill of the cycle that starts with the new term, and the supply charges billed on the agreement are reduced by the amount credited.

## Posting action

**Capability.** `post_renewal_loyalty_credit_25af361b` posts one renewal loyalty bill credit to a Residential Electricity Supply agreement. A new credit line of the renewal loyalty kind is added to the agreement's Beacon Ridge bill lines for the billing cycle given, carrying the amount as a negative (credit) value and today's posting date; it reduces the supply charges billed on the agreement and appears on that cycle's utility bill.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks `post_renewal_loyalty_credit_25af361b` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `power_agreement_id` | The residential electricity agreement number that receives the credit, as read from the agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `referred_customer_id` | The customer number of a referred customer named on the line; a renewal loyalty credit is not a referral credit and names no referred customer | Always the empty string "" |
| `billing_period_start` | The first day of the billing cycle on whose bill the credit appears | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `credit_amount_usd` | The size of the credit | Positive amount in USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; the line stores it signed as a negative credit |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new bill line number, the agreement, the cycle start date and the credited amount in USD. Receiving it means the credit line now stands on the bill.
